verdict.rationale: ClickUp lists a first-party "Automations" product and documents that workflows can be triggered from ClickUp events, and some integrations (Calendly, Salesforce) automatically create tasks on external events. The evidence is only labels and one-line claims, so the depth of user-defined rule building is unproven. Missing for 10: documentation of the rule builder (trigger/condition/action catalog), AI-assisted rule creation, limits/run history, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
